It deliberately records only the producer time-role transition, timestamped update/retraction, and recipient callback frontier; the separate DDM declaration contracts own the region/template/subscription declarations exercised by the same case. The synchronized 2025 Lab export has no drift and the exact native Catch2 selector is local development-profile evidence only, not package, JUnit, protected-review, interoperability, or conformance evidence.
